steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:8069/ in the browser and sign in to Odoo with login 'admin' and password 'admin'. Wait for the Odoo home/apps screen to load (do not wait for network idle - the app long-polls). Report what screen you see after login and the name of the logged-in user shown.

In Odoo Sales, open the existing quotation {{03-report.quotation_reference}} (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer', which currently has ONE order line: 'Conference Chair' quantity 3, untaxed amount £99.00). Add a SECOND order line with a DIFFERENT product (pick any other product from the catalogue - select it from the autocomplete dropdown options, not just typed) with quantity 2. Let Odoo fill the unit price. Save. Then report: (a) the product name of the new second line, (b) its unit price, and (c) the new untaxed amount shown in the totals section. Do not wait for network idle - wait on concrete page state instead.

recorded.new_line_product: Corner Desk Left Sit [FURN_1118] Corner Desk Left Sit

steps.instruction: In Odoo Sales, open the existing quotation {{03-report.quotation_reference}} (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer'). It has two order lines: line 1 'Conference Chair' quantity 3, line 2 'Corner Desk Left Sit' quantity 2, untaxed amount {{04-open.new_untaxed_amount}}. Change ONLY the first line's quantity from 3 to 5. Save. Then report the new untaxed amount shown in the totals section (and the total if visible). Do not wait for network idle - wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo Sales, open the existing quotation {{03-report.quotation_reference}} (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer', untaxed amount {{05-open.new_untaxed_amount}}). Confirm it so it becomes a sales order (use the Confirm button / Confirm Sale action). After confirmation, report: (a) the order reference name shown (e.g. {{03-report.quotation_reference}}), and (b) the status the app now shows for the order (look at the status bar / breadcrumb area, e.g. 'Sales Order', 'In Progress', etc.). Do not wait for network idle - wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo Sales, open the existing sales order {{03-report.quotation_reference}} (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer', status '{{06-open.order_status}}'). Cancel it so nothing stays active (use the Cancel button; if a confirmation dialog appears, accept it). After cancelling, report the status the app now shows for the order (look at the status bar / breadcrumb area). Do not wait for network idle - wait on concrete page state instead.

Verification only, no changes: In Odoo, open the sales order {{03-report.quotation_reference}} (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer'). Report exactly what the page shows now: the order reference, the current status in the status bar, the two order lines with their products and quantities, and the untaxed amount in the totals. Then also open the contact '{{runid}} Bench Customer' in the Contacts app and report its Name and City fields. Do not modify anything.
